title: 第16章 豪门千金（16）-《反派BOSS有毒》
content:
第(1/3)页

    被大汉挡住了视线的其他人看不到时笙手上拿的什么，但是一直用视屏监视的助理却看得清清楚楚。

    她手上拿的是一枚手榴弹，规格有点像军用的，但是和军用的又有些区别。

    大汉内心只有两个字——卧槽！

    这妹纸哪里来的这玩意！

    “你站着干什么，快把她绑起来！”南宫景等得有些不耐烦。

    大汉冷汗涔涔，果断往旁边站了一步，将时笙暴露出来，人家手上拿着手榴弹，他敢上去绑人吗？

    南宫景一开始还没认出那是什么，但是凌浩瞬间就认出来，脸色聚变，拉着苏衣衣立即退到了门边，“许乘月你疯了？”

    时笙抛了抛手上的东西，满脸鄙夷，“瞧你们那熊样，这就吓到了。这不过是个玩具，刚才在这房间找到的。”

    凌浩盯着时笙手上的手榴弹看了片刻，依旧没办法分辨真假，转念一想，她一个千金大小姐，哪能弄到手榴弹，更何况绑来之前还搜过身，她肯定是不能藏着这样的东西的。

    这别墅是他舅舅的，家里也有小孩，带过来度假的时候把玩具落下了也说得过去。

    “许乘月，死到临头你还有心思吓唬我，把他绑起来，我要让她好看。”凌浩阴沉着脸吩咐大汉，转头对着苏衣衣又是一脸的柔情，“衣衣，你先出去。”

    接下来的画面太血腥，不要让衣衣看到比较好。

    苏衣衣咬咬牙，拉了拉南宫景的衣袖，楚楚可怜的看着他。

    南宫景阴戾的眸子扫过时笙，带着苏衣衣出了房门，临走前苏衣衣暗中投给时笙嘲讽和得意的眼神。

    就算她失了清白又如何，这两个男人还是不把自己视若珍宝。

    大汉已经走到时笙面前，拿走了她手上的手榴弹，入手的时候大汉只觉得很真实，那手感和重量，都不像是玩具，大汉不免多看了几眼。

    时笙趁大汉分神的时候，身子猛的朝着窗户飞奔过去，她早就把窗户打开了，此时一推就开，大汉还没反应过来，时笙已经翻过了窗户。

    “真是可惜，本想直接解决你们三个的。”时笙说完这句话，直接跳下了下去。

    大汉手中的手榴弹在时笙滑落的瞬间，‘嘀’了一声，随后就是剧烈的爆破声。

    整座别墅都跟着抖了抖，二楼的窗户直接被炸飞，水泥块漫天溅落。

    下面一楼有一个平台，时笙跳下去并不会有什么危险，那爆炸的威力不是很大，并没有波及到时笙。

    在院子里的保镖听到爆炸声，抬头就看到站在平台上的时笙，几人直接冲了过去，想要抓住时笙。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Others whose sight was blocked by the big man couldn't see what Shi Sheng was holding, but the assistant who had been monitoring it with a video screen could see it clearly.

What she held in her hand was a grenade. Its specifications were a bit like military ones, but it was somewhat different from military ones.

There are only two words in the big man's heart - Fuck!

Where did this girl get this thing?

"What are you doing standing there? Tie her up quickly!" Nangong Jing waited impatiently.

The big man was sweating and took a decisive step to the side, exposing Shi Sheng. He had a grenade in his hand. Would he dare to kidnap someone?

Nangong Jing didn’t recognize what it was at first, but Ling Hao recognized it instantly, his expression changed, and he pulled Su Yiyi and immediately retreated to the door, "Xu Chengyue, are you crazy?"

Shi Sheng threw away the things in his hands, with contempt on his face, "Look at you guys, you are so scared. This is just a toy, I just found it in this room."

Ling Hao stared at the grenade in Shi Sheng's hand for a moment, but still couldn't tell whether it was real or fake. Then he thought about it, how could she, a rich lady, get a grenade? What's more, she had been searched before being kidnapped. She definitely couldn't hide such a thing.

This villa belongs to his uncle, and he has children at home, so it makes sense that he left his toys behind when he brought him here for vacation.

"Xu Chengyue, when death is imminent, you still have the intention to scare me and tie him up. I want to make her look good." Ling Hao ordered the big man with a sullen face. He turned to Su Yiyi with another tender look on his face, "Yiyi, you go out first."

The next scene is too bloody, so it’s better not to let Yiyi see it.

Su Yiyi gritted her teeth, pulled Nangong Jing's sleeves, and looked at him pitifully.

Nangong Jing’s sinister eyes glanced at Shi Sheng, and he led Su Yiyi out of the room. Before leaving, Su Yiyi secretly gave Shi Sheng a mocking and proud look.

Even if she loses her innocence, these two men still don't regard themselves as treasures.

The big man had already walked up to Shi Sheng and took the grenade from her hand. When he took it, he felt that it was very real. The feel and weight did not look like a toy. He couldn't help but look at it a few more times.

When the big man was distracted, Shi Sheng rushed toward the window. She had already opened the window, and it opened with a push. Before the big man could react, Shi Sheng had already climbed over the window.

"What a pity. I wanted to deal with you three directly." After Shi Sheng said this, he jumped down.

The grenade in the big man's hand made a 'tick' sound the moment Shi Sheng slipped, followed by a violent explosion.

The whole villa was shaking, the windows on the second floor were blown out, and cement blocks were splashed all over the sky.

There is a platform on the first floor below. There is no danger for Shi Sheng to jump down. The explosion was not very powerful and did not affect Shi Sheng.

The bodyguards in the yard heard the explosion and looked up to see Shi Sheng standing on the platform. Several people rushed over to catch Shi Sheng.
